headline.purpose: Fluid second-level index headings; document pages override size.

body.purpose: Open prose rhythm with a maximum 70ch paragraph measure.

small.purpose: Advisories, captions and footer; captions use line-height 1.5.

code.purpose: Document code; keyboard keys retain the prose family.

shadows.name: application-proof-only
shadows.purpose: Observed application-image treatment, not a generic elevation token.

motion.name: application-proof-settle-only
motion.purpose: Image-only reveal inside prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference; settle animates clip-path from inset(0 0 3% 0) to inset(0).

components.name: Download Link
components.description: The existing primary link control; not a synthesized form button.
components.css: .ds-download { display: inline-flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 32px; align-items: center; background: var(--accent, #006582); color: white; font-family: "Segoe UI Variable", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.65; font-weight: 650; padding: 16px 22px; text-decoration: none; border-radius: 5px; margin-top: 10px; } .ds-download:hover { background: #004c63; color: white; } .ds-download:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent, #006582); outline-offset: 5px; border-radius: 2px; }

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Visible wrapping text navigation, with no invented menu or selected state.
components.html: User guideDevelopersGitHub
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 28px; font-family: "Segoe UI Variable", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; line-height: 1.65; } .ds-nav a { color: var(--ink, #102c44); font-size: .95rem; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: .2em; } .ds-nav a:hover { color: #003f52; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent, #006582); outline-offset: 5px; border-radius: 2px; } @media (max-width: 760px) { .ds-nav { gap: 20px; } }

components.name: Emphasized Reading Link
components.description: An underlined route into the longer documentation.
components.html: Read the complete user guide →
components.css: .ds-text-link { color: var(--accent, #006582); font-family: "Segoe UI Variable", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.65; font-weight: 650; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: .2em; } .ds-text-link:hover { color: #003f52; } .ds-text-link:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent, #006582); outline-offset: 5px; border-radius: 2px; }

components.name: Keyboard Keys
components.description: Static semantic keycaps from the recovery explanation; no interactive states apply.
components.css: .ds-shortcut { color: var(--ink, #102c44); font-family: "Segoe UI Variable", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.65; margin: 0 0 22px; max-width: 70ch; } .ds-key { font: inherit; font-size: .85em; border: 1px solid var(--line, #b7ccdc); border-bottom-width: 2px; border-radius: 3px; padding: 2px 5px; white-space: nowrap; background: white; }

components.name: Document Code Block
components.description: The implemented document code styling; specimen text is illustrative, with no invented state.
components.css: .ds-code-block { overflow-x: auto; background: var(--ink, #102c44); color: #f3f8fc; padding: 20px; border-radius: 5px; font-family: "Segoe UI Variable", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.65; } .ds-code-block code { font-family: Consolas, monospace; font-size: .9em; overflow-wrap: normal; }

narrative.overview:
A pale-blue reading workspace uses Windows system typography, deep ink text and restrained cyan-teal actions. Its identity is native-adjacent, not a replacement design for the Windows executable. Real application imagery provides product evidence; the surrounding website remains light and readable.

The visual system favors generous section spacing, clear heading hierarchy, underlined links and thin dividing lines. Most surfaces are flat; a tonal contributor panel and the lifted application image provide bounded contrast.
keyCharacteristics: Pale-blue canvas with ink text and cyan-teal links.
Windows system typography with fluid, tightly set headings.
Open reading sections, thin rules and restrained corners.
Real native imagery, separated from website styling.

rules.name: The Reading Canvas Rule
rules.body: Keep the website light; the dark application capture is evidence, not the website's theme.

rules.name: The Windows Voice Rule
rules.body: Use the existing system-font stack for website headings and prose; reserve the distinct monospace stack for code.

rules.name: The Bounded Depth Rule
rules.body: Preserve the current distinction between flat reading sections, the tonal contributor panel and the lifted application image.

dos: **Do** keep the pale-blue canvas, ink hierarchy and cyan-teal link roles.
**Do** preserve Windows system typography and readable prose measures.
**Do** retain underlines, the keyboard-visible focus outline and the skip link.
**Do** keep real application imagery distinct from website components.
**Do** preserve source order when the existing grids stack on mobile.
donts: **Don't** convert the dark application screenshot into a website dark-theme mandate.
**Don't** invent form controls, generic cards or states absent from the stylesheet.
**Don't** promote index-page composition or image-only treatments into universal rules.
**Don't** treat synthesized sidecar color ramps as shipped palette tokens.
**Don't** apply this website record to the native executable.
